title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 4: Israel's defeat by the Philistines, the capture of the ark, and the death of Eli.

questions.text: Where did the Philistines encamp before the battle?
questions.explanation: Israel encamped beside Ebenezer, and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

questions.text: About how many men of Israel did the Philistines kill in the first battle?
questions.explanation: Israel was defeated, and the Philistines killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

questions.text: What did the elders of Israel decide to do after the first defeat?
questions.explanation: They said, "Let's get the ark of Yahweh's covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us."

answers.text: Choose a king to lead them
Bring the ark of the covenant from Shiloh
Burn the camp of the Philistines

questions.text: What happened when the ark of Yahweh's covenant came into the camp?
questions.explanation: All Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

answers.text: Israel shouted so that the earth resounded
Fire came down from the sky
The people fell silent and wept

questions.text: What did the Philistines say these mighty gods had done?
questions.explanation: They said, "These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness."

answers.text: Brought down the walls of Jericho

questions.text: How many footmen of Israel fell in the second battle?
questions.explanation: There was a very great slaughter; thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

questions.text: From which tribe was the man who ran to Shiloh with the news?
questions.explanation: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head.

questions.text: How old was Eli when the news came?
questions.explanation: Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were set so that he could not see.
When the ark was mentioned, Eli fell backward from his seat by the side of the gate, and his neck broke, for he was old and heavy.

answers.text: He was killed by the Philistines in battle
He died in his sleep that night
He was struck by the man of Benjamin
He fell backward from his seat and broke his neck

questions.text: What did Phinehas' wife name her son?
questions.explanation: She named the child Ichabod, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel!"
